text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One afternoon—while taking a break at a cafe, the neighboring table suddenly became lively.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Grass-san! Um... for coming to my tea party! Er, that is to say...
I am totally, utterly hyped to the max, waaa~~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to say
"honored by your presence"!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —My apologies, Grass-san. Thank you for putting up with our practice.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not at all~. I was just in the mood for a little breather, so I'm glad if I can be of any help.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Are you listening, Kawakami-san? For a first-class tea party, showing consideration to your invited guest is essential.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Roger that, wa! In that case, Grass-san, please take the innermost seat!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, would moving be a bother?! Allow me to carry you in a princess carry!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-Wait right there! Consideration is fine and well, but doing that will kick up dust everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Grass-san, pray wait just a moment!! I shall rip these scones apart with my bare hands so they're easier to eat—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Guests can break their own scones! In this situation, it's far better to ask something like, "What kind of jam would you prefer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Kawakami Princess's high-powered tea party continued to unfold—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you for the wonderful treat♪ Every single sweet you prepared was simply delicious.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I am honored they suited your palate! Ah, Grass-san, allow me to pour you a refi—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa-aaah?! The teapot's falling oveeeer?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you...! You aren't hurt, are you? I'll clean up the broken pieces, so go grab a towel to wipe this up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! Right away!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Phew... Forgive us, Grass-san. That girl is truly reckless to a fault...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I wonder if this is how an older sister feels when dealing with a handful of a little sister.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes... indeed...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Dad told me the news.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "I hear you've been doing remarkably well in your races over there. As your older sister, I'm truly proud of you."

text_block_list.name: Grass's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: "Heheh! Just watch, I'm gonna keep getting stronger and overtake you in no time, Onee-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Oh my, how terrifying~. Your big sister might just get flustered at this rate."

text_block_list.name: Grass's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: "...What's with that? You're not taking me seriously at all, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Fufu, that's not true. I genuinely believe that you will grow much, much stronger~."

text_block_list.name: Grass's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: "—Ugh, not at all! You're not flustered, and you're not taking me seriously...! That's no fun at all!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...? Grass-san, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Fufufu, no. I was just thinking how heartwarming your relationship is.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: King-chan gently guiding Kawakami-san. Kawakami-san looking up to King-chan with utter devotion. ...It is truly a wonderful bond.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, yes... As unrefined and demanding as she can be, she is still like an adorable little sister to me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why, as her senior, I must guide her properly. So that she won't stumble when it matters most—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that is admirable. The duty of those who walk ahead, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: (King-chan and Kawakami-san complement each other so beautifully and have built such a good relationship...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: (Just like the two of them—I hope that girl and I can manage to get along well eventually...)
